releaseNotes.en:
• SafePocket v0.4.0 eliminates Google Play Protect dropper false-positives by removing REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES and in-APK package installer sessions in favor of verified HTTPS release downloads.
• Introduces Cross-Platform Zero-Knowledge Cloud Sync v2 (deterministic PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 100k-round Cloud Sync Key, canonical wire schema across Android/macOS/PWA, Pull-First CRDT reconciliation, real tombstones, and instant 5-second live background sync).
releaseNotes.de:
• SafePocket v0.4.0 beseitigt Google-Play-Protect-Warnungen durch Entfernen von REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES und In-App-APK-Installationen zugunsten verifizierter HTTPS-Downloads.
• Führt Cross-Platform Zero-Knowledge Cloud-Sync v2 ein (deterministischer PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256-Schlüssel, einheitliches Schema für Android/macOS/PWA, Pull-First-CRDT-Abgleich, echte Lösch-Tombstones und sofortige Live-Synchronisation alle 5 Sekunden).
releaseNotes.it: • SafePocket v0.4.0 elimina i falsi positivi di Google Play Protect rimuovendo REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES e introduce Cloud Sync Zero-Knowledge multipiattaforma v2 istantaneo tra Android, macOS e PWA.
releaseNotes.fr: • SafePocket v0.4.0 élimine les alertes Google Play Protect en supprimant REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES et introduit la synchronisation Cloud Zero-Knowledge multiplateforme v2 instantanée entre Android, macOS et PWA.
releaseNotes.es: • SafePocket v0.4.0 elimina las alertas de Google Play Protect al retirar REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES e introduce sincronización en la nube Zero-Knowledge multiplataforma v2 instantánea entre Android, macOS y PWA.
releaseNotes.el: • Το SafePocket v0.4.0 εξαλείφει τις προειδοποιήσεις του Google Play Protect αφαιρώντας το REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES και εισάγει άμεσο συγχρονισμό Cloud Zero-Knowledge v2 σε πραγματικό χρόνο μεταξύ Android, macOS και PWA.
